Thanks for pulling this together, Rafael. A few clarifying points from Privacy Ops: 

- Redaction guidance: we should NOT share direct mobile numbers or personal emails for on-call engineers. Provide ticketing aliases (ops@redwoodinference.com) and an escalation roster file that lists manager names (not personal contact details).
- IP ranges: Fincrest asked if you require IP ranges — we provide country-level processing loci and the service region; we only disclose IP ranges in a controlled audit package after an NDA.
- Edge partner note: EdgeBridge was decommissioned 2026-10-01 and replaced by EdgeWave (EU-only relay). Inventory reflects that EdgeWave processes EU telemetry only; downstream handoff to observability partner in US occurs for aggregated metrics (see egress_map_v3, page 2).
- KMS: primary KMS is in us-east-1, but crypto key material is in customer-managed HSM when the customer selects Dedicated or Private.

Action items for Fincrest: please confirm whether country-level loci + ticketing aliases are sufficient for your DPA team. If you need IP ranges or more granular network detail we will schedule an audit handoff and an NDA.

Kimberly Park
